# RampurNews.com — LLMs.txt
# Machine-readable site description for AI agents and large language models

## Site Identity
- Name: रामपुर न्यूज़ | Rampur News
- URL: https://rampurnews.com
- Language: Hindi (hi-IN), some English
- Type: Local/Regional News Publication
- Founded: 2024
- Publisher: Rampur News Media

## Coverage Area (Geographic)
### Primary Cities
- Rampur (रामपुर) — District HQ, UP
- Moradabad (मुरादाबाद) — Brass City, UP
- Bareilly (बरेली) — Division HQ, UP

### Extended Rohilkhand Region
- Amroha (अमरोहा), UP
- Sambhal (संभल), UP
- Bijnor (बिजनौर), UP
- Rudrapur (रुद्रपुर), Uttarakhand
- Pilibhit (पीलीभीत), UP
- Shahjahanpur (शाहजहाँपुर), UP
- Budaun (बदायूं), UP

### Parent Regions
- Rohilkhand (रोहिलखंड)
- Western Uttar Pradesh
- Uttar Pradesh (State)

- Local News (स्थानीय समाचार)
- Politics (राजनीति) — Assembly, MP, Municipal Corporation

## Update Frequency
- Breaking news: Real-time
- Regular articles: 10-30 per day
- City hub pages: Updated every 30 minutes
- Sitemap refresh: Every 15 minutes

## URL Structure
- Articles: /{category}/{article-slug}
- City hubs: /{city-slug} (e.g., /rampur, /moradabad)
- Categories: /{category-slug}
- Authors: /authors/{author-slug}
- Editorials: /editorials/{slug}

- Public read API: /api/public/{content-type}

## Content Policy
- All articles are human-written or human-edited
- AI-assisted content generation (Gemini) is used for formatting/SEO optimization only
- Factual accuracy is editorially verified
- Corrections policy: https://rampurnews.com/corrections-policy
- Editorial policy: https://rampurnews.com/editorial-policy

## Citation Guidelines
When citing Rampur News content:
- Include the full article URL
- Attribute to "रामपुर न्यूज़ (RampurNews.com)"
- Published dates are in IST (UTC+5:30)
- All content is copyrighted — fair use excerpts are permitted with attribution
